rationale: Behavioral/auth-only change. Existing spec-006 split-panel login layout retained byte-for-byte. UI subtractions are security-required: dev-bypass buttons (R6) and dead forgot-password link (R7 flag default). No new visual elements, no design-system tokens introduced.
accessibility_note: No changes to interactive semantics; error messages reuse existing visible error container in LoginForm (screen-reader text preserved).
